objective: Test whether the fixed DNA composition model predicts the across-context component of published reporter activity on grouped held-out elements. This component cannot in general be reconstructed from centered specificity.

exposure.known: All earlier S9 specificity values, models, arithmetic diagnostics and public methods/code/schema hypotheses are known. The final official archive is currently downloading under the separately frozen endpoint-recovery protocol; no new workbook headers or activity values have been inspected by this team at this freeze.
exposure.independence: Same source experiment and selected panel as prior specificity study. This is a separately versioned endpoint analysis, not independent biological replication or outcome-naive source selection.

source.selection: Exact official final Table11 member, published observed activity aggregate only. No ESS inversion, predictions, guessed columns or alternative source if gates fail.

gates: Official archive and selected member integrity independently verified under endpoint-recovery protocol.
Header-only schema binding confirms exact empirical activity columns and their published log2(RNA/DNA) units and within-study replicate context. Predicted or ambiguous scores block fitting.
All 55276 pre-existing admitted IDs have unique finite values in all three declared activity columns. No subset selection or imputation. Missing coverage blocks this v3.
Final design workbook byte-identical to the pinned original S7; exact DNA/coordinate identity of the admitted panel is preserved.

Recover and publish replicate-aggregate arithmetic status and all normalization uncertainties before fitting. The v3 endpoint is the unchanged published aggregate columns. It is not a claim that the blocked v1 normalization contract has passed.

endpoint.transform: None. Preserve published source float values exactly; no outcome centering, variance scaling, ESS projection or count reconstruction.
endpoint.units: Published library-normalized log2(RNA/DNA), not absolute transcripts per cell. Source full-library normalization and QC already precede grouped splitting.
endpoint.aggregation_uncertainty: Arithmetic checks and historical normalization provenance are reported separately. A literal published-aggregate binding does not establish raw count reconstruction or technical-noise calibration.

panel.use: DNA/metadata only; ignore old ESS outcome fields for all v3 fitting.

grouping.use: Reuse exact prior outcome-independent 2761 components, five folds and whole-component 10kb guards without recomputing by activity. All contexts and occurrences of an element retain their one split. Preserve exact source group receipt.

features.definition: Identical fixed 32 reverse-complement-canonical overlapping 3mer frequencies plus GC fraction, in prior v2 order. No length, source IDs, activity bins, support counts or ESS predictors.
features.training_processing: Population means and standard deviations from each outer training fold only; SD <=1e-12 replaced with1.

models.S: Shared DNA ridge slopes fitted to one across-cell mean activity per training element, free intercept.
models.A: Exactly the S slopes plus per-cell training intercepts.
models.objective: Summed SSE with unpenalized intercept, same slope penalty for S and each I fit. No hyperparameter tuning.

primary.metric: Equal-element, equal-cell out-of-fold MSE, original activity units squared.
primary.improvement: MSE(C)-MSE(A); positive means shared DNA improves prediction beyond context mean.
primary.question: Can these fixed DNA composition features predict the common across-context activity component on whole held-out sequence/locus groups?
primary.no_success_requirement: Retain negative or zero improvement unchanged.

secondary: A versus I MSE and MAE, describing context-dependent slopes.
All five model MSE and MAE by cell and pooled, equal-component sensitivity, every fold.
Across-cell mean activity prediction from S versus the training across-cell mean; check equality of its MSE improvement to the C-versus-A primary gain.
All three pairwise cell-contrast MSEs and existing balanced-design linearity identities. These are correlated diagnostics, not additional independent confirmations.

uncertainty.method: 2000 paired component bootstrap draws from the same lexicographic component order, SplitMix64 seed0x2026102702; sample 2761 groups with replacement. Ratio of member loss sums to member counts for equal-element primary estimand.
uncertainty.interval: Type7 quantiles0.025 and0.975, conditional on frozen fits and this selected same-study panel; no refit, calibrated p-value or genome-wide prevalence inference.

independent_reproduction.requirement: Independent Python reconstruction of exact published raw activity values, training-only fits, all829140 predictions, all model errors and 2000 paired resamples. Reuse independently verified DNA/group metadata, with all raw/source bindings retained.
independent_reproduction.features: Exact integer counts and exact existing DNA-derived feature vectors.

outputs: Exact source and protocol bindings, schema gate and coverage ledger.
All fits, scalers, coefficients, held-out observations/predictions, component/fold memberships and errors.
All paired bootstrap draws and model/comparison statistics.
Independent comparison with every failed check retained.
Standalone figures, numeric tables, limits and source/implementation manifests.
claims: A bounded computational study of source-selected 200nt reporter constructs in three measured cells. No unseen cell, independent source, causal regulatory mechanism, clinical consequence, absolute expression calibration or global-first discovery claim.
failure_policy: Stop fitting on a source/schema/coverage gate failure. Preserve every attempt. Implementation corrections retain earlier artifacts and never alter endpoint, features, alpha, folds, metrics or targets to improve results.
